div.div:
Expiring signed event manifest for a specific scanner device/session.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
scanner_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
session_id: uuid [FK NN]
device_id: uuid [FK NN]
file_id: uuid [FK NN]
snapshot_version: bigint [NN]
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
content_hash: text [NN]
signing_key_id: text [NN]
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (id, event_id, device_id)
CK1: snapshot_version >= 0
CK2: expires_at > created_at
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(session_id, scanner_user_id) -> auth_session(id, user_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(device_id, scanner_user_id) -> scanner_device(id, owner_user_id) [1 parent / 0..*
children]
(event_id) -> event(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(file_id) -> stored_file(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Retained raw client intent and per-operation reconciliation outcome; not authoritative
admission.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
package_id: uuid [FK NN]
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
device_id: uuid [FK NN]
operation_id: uuid [NN]
sequence_number: bigint [NN]
kind: text [NN]
claimed_ticket_id: uuid [?]
claimed_confirmation_id: uuid [?]
parent_operation_id: uuid [?]
captured_at: timestamptz [NN]
payload_hash: text [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'received'
resolved_ticket_id: uuid [FK ?]
accepted_check_in_id: uuid [FK ?]
rejection_code: text [?]
processed_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (device_id, operation_id)
UQ2: (package_id, sequence_number)
CK1: sequence_number > 0
CK2: kind IN ('check_in','reverse')
CK3: status IN ('received','accepted','duplicate','rejected','conflict')
CK4: (kind = 'reverse') = (parent_operation_id IS NOT NULL)
CK5: status = 'received' OR processed_at IS NOT NULL
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(package_id, event_id, device_id) -> offline_package(id, event_id, device_id) [1 parent /
0..* children]
(resolved_ticket_id, event_id) -> ticket(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(accepted_check_in_id) -> check_in(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Organizer review of conflicting provisional operation; cannot create a second admission.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
offline_operation_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
existing_check_in_id: uuid [FK ?]
status: text [NN]
default 'open'
reason: text [NN]
resolved_by_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
resolution_note: text [?]
resolved_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (offline_operation_id)
CK1: status IN ('open','resolved')
CK2: status <> 'resolved' OR (resolved_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL
AND resolution_note IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(offline_operation_id) -> offline_operation(id) [1 parent / 0..1 children]
(existing_check_in_id) -> check_in(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(resolved_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
